title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Dangerous-Goods Uplift Left Out of a Disputed Amount
content:
## Clause

On a Demurrage and Detention Free Time demurrage line disputed for misapplied rates or free time, whatever dangerous-goods uplift sits inside the open balance belongs to the terminal, to which the line passes it on, and so it forms no part of the sum the billed party challenges.

- **Dangerous-goods booking:** the uplift portion of the open balance is excluded from the dispute. Its size is the open balance divided by the total of 100 and the product's uplift percentage, then multiplied by that percentage.
- **Booking of any other cargo type:** nothing is excluded.

## Why the share takes that shape

A demurrage amount that carries an uplift is the plain amount increased by the uplift percentage of itself. Dividing by 100 plus the percentage and multiplying by the percentage isolates exactly the uplift contained in it.

## Illustration (hypothetical percentage)

Amount still open 900.00, dangerous-goods booking, uplift assumed at 20 percent: the share is 900.00 divided by 120 and then multiplied by 20, which is 150.00. On a booking of another cargo type the share is nothing.
